name: AddSearchResult
caption: Add search result

configuration.description: What the user sees as the result. SmartText. Trimmed, cut to 100 characters.
Second description line. SmartText, cut to 50.
Business Central Vendor No. of the supplier. SmartText, cut to 20, upper-cased. Together with vendorItemNo it identifies an item imported earlier.
The supplier's item number. SmartText, cut to 50.
Manufacturer part number. SmartText, cut to 50.
Link to a picture of the item. SmartText, cut to 2048.
Unit the prices refer to. SmartText, cut to 10, upper-cased.

Purchase price the supplier offers. SmartText. Resolved text is read as a number: empty = 0; both 1234.5 and 1234,5 work, and a thousands separator next to the decimal one is dropped (1,234.50 / 1.234,50). Anything else fails the step.

Sales price, e.g. the recommended retail price. SmartText. Resolved text is read as a number: empty = 0; both 1234.5 and 1234,5 work, and a thousands separator next to the decimal one is dropped (1,234.50 / 1.234,50). Anything else fails the step.

Quantity the supplier has in stock. SmartText. Resolved text is read as a number: empty = 0; both 1234.5 and 1234,5 work, and a thousands separator next to the decimal one is dropped (1,234.50 / 1.234,50). Anything else fails the step.

Enum input: {"mode":"fixed"|"smarttext"|"rules", "value":"InStock", "smartText":"...", "rules":[{"condition":"<SmartFilter>","value":"InStock"}], "otherwise":"Unknown"}. A plain string is read like smarttext. The resolved text may be the value name (InStock, LowStock, OutOfStock, OnOrder, Unknown), the caption in the user's language (In Stock) or the ordinal; case-insensitive. Empty or no matching rule without otherwise = blank; any other text = Unknown.

Anything the import needs later (e.g. the supplier's product id or the whole JSON of the hit). Not shown to the user; passed unchanged to the SearchSelected trigger's Payload output. SmartText, no length limit.

notes: Requires the AutoFlow Supplier Foundation app. See docs/apps/SupplierFoundation.md.
Offered in the step picker only in flows whose trigger is ItemSearch (5564012). Also works in a SubFlow called from such a flow, because the results are collected per session.
Not terminating; call it once per hit, typically inside a For Each over the supplier's answer.
No outputs. The step's effect is the row it adds to the search results.
Values longer than a field are cut without an error.
Before showing the result, Supplier Foundation looks up an Item Vendor entry with vendorNo + vendorItemNo; the match is handed to the selection flow as ExistingItemNo.
